Keep the established package/signature for an in-place update. For a separate new application, choose unique app IDs and configure its own signing and Google restrictions.

text:
GEOSERVER_BBOX stores a fixed full extent for the web API response.

Use minX,minY,maxX,maxY in the request CRS.

Changing it alone does not recenter every mobile map.

Seeded WMS templates request EPSG:3857. ANF formatWmsUrl normalizes to EPSG:900913, the equivalent Web Mercator identifier used in that helper. Values are projected meters. Ordinary BuildingMapScreen consumes seeded placeholders directly. Its code does not read response.bbox for initial camera positioning. Do not replace per-tile placeholders with one fixed municipality bbox.
